sentences.text: No: as of 2026-11-23, the 2023 circular on penal charges and its timeline extension have been withdrawn and are no longer in force.

For an Upper Co-operative Bank, the in-force rule to cite today is the 2025 UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, which apply to this bank and permit penal charges only under the stated conditions.
Those current directions also state that penal interest is not permitted for this bank.
